name: Tinker: Restorative Beacon heals an opposite-faction party member (#9801)
contract: #9801 reports beacons that do not affect opposite-faction dungeon finder party members. Restorative Beacon 801801 summons 50037; 3000 ms after the summon and every 1000 ms afterwards, the beacon casts 706829 (SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID, radius index 13 = 10 yd, BasePoints 124 + DieSides 2 before the Tinker level scaling) for each raid ally in range. A grouped Orc 1 yd away at 100 health must gain health from it. An ungrouped Orc at the same distance must stay at 100 health. Regeneration is off for both players.

steps.label: SETUP: the Restorative Beacon is summoned
The beacon heals the opposite-faction party member
The beacon does not heal an ungrouped opposite-faction player
